on_battle_start: The spirits whisper of your arrival. I am Pai, the first of the Elite Four.
Death is not the end here. Let the ghosts show you true fear.
on_battle_won: Your spirit fades before mine. Come back once you've grown stronger.
The Elite Four is no place for the faint of heart.
on_battle_lost: Even in defeat, the spirits respect your courage. Proceed, challenger.
You've bested the first trial. The Elite Four awaits your next step.
